name: Bala Ged
description: Bala Ged is a continent of Zendikar, the home of Nissa and the Joraga, destroyed by the Eldrazi.

description_citations.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.
"Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

summary.text: Bala Ged is a continent of Zendikar, the home of Nissa and the Joraga, destroyed by the Eldrazi.

citations.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.
"Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

bio.text: Ulamog destroyed Bala Ged first when he escaped his prison, and Gideon was told that it had been overrun.

citations.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.
"Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

bio.text: Ob Nixilis felt its destruction and sensed his spark within reach.

citations.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

bio.text: A vampire offered Nissa the last bloodbriar seed of Bala Ged to take to another plane.

citations.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

bio.text: Nissa later arrived and found it entirely consumed by white corruption, though a new bloom grew there around the Khalni Heart.

citations.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.
"Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

bio.text: Nahiri later found it turned to lifeless gray dust.

citations.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

status.text: As of the latest story that describes it, Bala Ged is a devastated, Eldrazi-ravaged continent, though it has a new bloom growing around the Khalni Heart.

citations.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.
"Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis says that heroes coming to fight the Eldrazi will need what he knows about the hedrons, and that he feels his spark within reach after Bala Ged's destruction.
timeline.quote: My spark is within reach.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Munda and his band find Gideon and tell him that Bala Ged has been overrun and destroyed.
timeline.quote: Bala Ged, the entire continent, has be overrun and destroyed.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: The vampire offers four seeds from Anowon, including the last bloodbriar of Bala Ged, asking Nissa to take them to another plane.
timeline.quote: "Kolya, red mangrove, jaddi, bloodbriar."

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa arrives on Bala Ged and finds it entirely consumed by white corruption.
timeline.quote: The land wasn't ruined—it had been entirely consumed.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa walks to the site of her old village and is overwhelmed by memories of her past self and her departure.
timeline.quote: She wouldn't be that elf again, she couldn't be.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa instinctively kills a gomazoa-like Eldrazi and realizes it must have fed on life, leading her toward Khalni Heart.
timeline.quote: She quartered the monstrosity so quickly

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Following the Eldrazi's trail to a surrakar cave, Nissa finds a moss-lined tunnel.
timeline.quote: she saw the first sign of life.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa finds a ring of hedrons imprisoning the wilted Khalni Heart and realizes someone uprooted Zendikar's soul.
timeline.quote: someone had uprooted the land's soul and trapped it here to die.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: A demon attacks Nissa, mistaking her for Nahiri's emissary, and they fight.
timeline.quote: "Was it Nahiri?"

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa unleashes her wild essence to reflect the demon's life-draining blast.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, the full force of Nissa's essence came rushing back to her

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The demon reveals he plans to seize Khalni Heart's power, and Nissa breaks a hedron to open the prison.
timeline.quote: the massive rock shattered.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa touches Khalni Heart but the demon traps her and tells her to planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: "If you want to live, now is the time to planeswalk away."

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes she is neither her old self nor her controlled self and pours her essence into Khalni Heart, letting it root in the land.
timeline.quote: Nissa collected all the power left within her

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The land swallows Khalni Heart and Zendikar's soul returns to the land, defeating the demon's plan.
timeline.quote: The world's soul had returned to the land.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa drives a fist of land into the demon and rises with Ashaya, who returns as her friend.
timeline.quote: Nissa rose up, and so too did the world's soul, her friend.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya set off to return to Sea Gate and join Gideon's battle cry.
timeline.quote: Nissa and Ashaya would return to Sea Gate, they would meet Gideon's army

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis wakes buried alive after Nissa took Khalni Heart and collapsed the cavern on him.
timeline.quote: She left me alive.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis recalls his failed plan to synchronize a hedron network with Khalni Heart and reignite his spark.
timeline.quote: Synchronize a hedron network with Khalni Heart, and use it to channel enough planar energy through my body to reignite my spark.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis weighs his options and decides he must save Zendikar to buy time to rebuild his work.
timeline.quote: I was going to have to save Zendikar.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: He digs himself out over days, finding Bala Ged stripped of life so there is nothing to drain.
timeline.quote: The entire process of escape took days.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: He recovers the keystone hedron of his network and uses it to sense where the last stand will be.
timeline.quote: Sea Gate, if memory served. A lovely place for a slaughter.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa finds the Khalni Heart in Bala Ged, restores her connection to Zendikar and defeats Ob Nixilis.
timeline.quote: Nissa bested Ob Nixilis , removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and left the demon seething underground.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds Bala Ged turned to lifeless gray dust.
timeline.quote: What stretched before her was a seemingly endless expanse of chalky gray dust

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sees Ulamog on the horizon.
timeline.quote: The Devourer. The one Ugin called Ulamog .

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri swears that as Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad, and as she has wept, so will Sorin.
timeline.quote: As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra snaps at Nissa asking if she even has a mother, and Nissa reveals that Ulamog destroyed her people's home of Bala Ged.
timeline.quote: it was the first place he destroyed

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa races to Bala Ged along the leylines, finally home.
timeline.quote: Nissa was finally home.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.
